{{Top|leg}}
The '''Eye of Tulak''' was an ancient [[Sith artifact/Legends|Sith artifact]] that was discovered by the [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Paladius]] by the time of the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]]. In this time, he took the relic with him to [[Nar Shaddaa/Legends|Nar Shaddaa]] where he established a cult amongst the lower classes. [[Darth Zash]] dispatched her [[Sith apprentice/Legends|apprentice]] [[Darth Nox|Kallig]] to Nar Shaddaa in order to retrieve the [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] artifact that was assembled with others as part of a ritual to be conducted on [[Dromund Kaas/Legends|Dromund Kaas]].
